This stalk is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known throughout Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it must be prepared as an infusion or decoction.

The decoction helps knit shattered fractures provided the bone is kept completely immobile for twelve hours. It is also called Bursthelas.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
